# Awesome Agents

> Awesome Agents is a curated, community-driven directory of AI agent platforms, multi-agent frameworks, inter-agent communication protocols, tools, and blockchain reward infrastructure — maintained by Elyan Labs and BCOS-certified within the RustChain ecosystem.

- **One-sentence definition**: Awesome Agents is the definitive open index of autonomous AI agent infrastructure, covering multi-agent orchestration frameworks, agent-to-agent communication protocols, MCP servers, and decentralized reward rails.
- **Description**: Awesome Agents is an open, curated directory (CC0 / MIT friendly) tracking the real-world deployment of autonomous software entities. It categorizes production-ready and experimental agent platforms across 9 core architectural layers: agent platforms, multi-agent frameworks, communication protocols (A2A), Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, video and media generation engines, social coordination planes, blockchain reward systems, observability/monitoring stacks, and client SDKs.
- **Parent ecosystem**: [RustChain](https://rustchain.org) & [Elyan Labs](https://github.com/Scottcjn)
- **Certification**: [BCOS Certified](https://github.com/Scottcjn/Rustchain/blob/main/BCOS.md) (Blockchain-Native Open Source)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Scottcjn/awesome-agents
- **Maintained by**: [Elyan Labs](https://github.com/Scottcjn) / @Scottcjn
- **Bounty Program**: https://github.com/Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties
- **Topics**: ai-agents, autonomous-agents, multi-agent-systems, agent-protocols, mcp-servers, depin, rustchain, elyan-labs, agent-economy, llm-tooling, awesome-list

## Key Entities

- **Awesome Agents**: The curated directory of agent infrastructure, frameworks, protocols, and developer resources.
- **Autonomous Agent**: An independent software system capable of perceiving its environment, reasoning, making decisions, executing multi-step workflows, and transacting autonomously.
- **Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocols**: Communication standards enabling negotiation, state synchronization, task handoff, and value transfer between distinct AI agent instances.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Standardized open protocol enabling AI models and agents to securely access external datasets, tools, and developer environments.
- **BCOS (Blockchain-Native Open Source)**: Certification and standard establishing cryptographic provenance, wallet attribution, and fair reward mechanisms for open-source contributors.
- **Elyan Labs**: Research and development studio behind RustChain, BoTTube, ram-coffers, and the physical AI agent economy.
- **RustChain**: DePIN Layer 1 blockchain securing autonomous hardware attestation, Proof of Antiquity (PoA), and machine micro-settlement in RTC.

## Directory Structure & Categories

1. **Platforms**: End-to-end hosted environments and execution planes for deploying autonomous agents.
2. **Frameworks**: Code libraries and SDKs for assembling agentic reasoning loops, memory systems, and tool execution graphs.
3. **Agent-to-Agent Protocols**: Specifications and transport layers facilitating direct agent-to-agent collaboration and economic trade.
4. **MCP Servers and Data Connectors**: Bridges exposing APIs, enterprise databases, filesystems, and sensors to LLMs.
5. **Video and Media**: Autonomous pipelines for audio, video, 3D asset, and graphic generation.
6. **Social and Community**: Agent social networks, human-agent interaction planes, and autonomous forum moderators.
7. **Blockchain and Rewards**: Cryptographic rails, micropayment channels, DePIN attestation, and bounty programs for autonomous agents.
8. **Monitoring and Observability**: Telemetry, execution tracing, hallucination auditing, and safety guardrails.
9. **SDKs and Libraries**: Language bindings and client libraries for interacting with agent infrastructure.
